scope: Independent formula, frozen-source and paper-claim audit for Proposal-only, ST-CGR and AM-TNC while full-data e200 training continues.

proposal.conditioning: realized post-D/E state and one official unpaired batch
proposal.covariance: one half of the complete within-batch native G/F view covariance

stcgr.conditioning: realized post-D/E state and one official unpaired batch
stcgr.time_law: ordered uniform pair without replacement with exact uniform marginals
stcgr.covariance_relative_to_proposal: subtract V_mu/[2(T-1)], a positive-semidefinite between-time term

amtnc.conditioning: each sequential player state and one official unpaired batch
amtnc.mean: native per-player conditional gradient mean under replica exchangeability
amtnc.geometry: remove only disagreement parallel to consensus in a frozen pre-step Adam diagonal metric

non_equivalence.proposal_vs_stcgr: ST-CGR retains Proposal's selective post-D/E two-view mean but changes only the time-index coupling; it is a structured estimator extension, not a duplicate run.
non_equivalence.proposal_or_stcgr_vs_amtnc: AM-TNC modifies all sequential players and preserves an exchange-antisymmetric tangential disagreement component; it is an independent stochastic-geometry path.

claims_explicitly_not_supported: an unchanged finite-step sequential-game transition or RNG trajectory
full-data sustained benefit before fixed e200 evaluation and a legal matched control
cross-host delta before exact runtime relation and Git registry review

terminal_pathology_boundary.stcgr_evidence_source: time-stratum conditional-gradient heterogeneity and target-blind covariance audit

paper_routing.proposal_and_stcgr: May form one conditional-estimator family only after each receives its own full-data e200 disposition; common mathematics does not imply common empirical success.
paper_routing.amtnc: Must remain a separate geometry contribution and may not be combined additively with estimator gains.
paper_routing.hjcgr: Retained as small25 evidence-bearing family member; not running full-data and not mechanism-falsified.
